info.title: DecisionDriven.Report
info.description:
The whole-graph reports that a single compilation cannot produce: the tier-3 half of
      decision-driven design. A .NET tool, run in CI against a built solution.

options.name: --assembly
options.description: a built assembly, or a directory whose *.dll are read; repeat for more

options.name: --repo
options.description: the repository root, for git history (default: the current directory)

options.name: --ledger
options.description: the ledger directory, relative to the repository (default: docs/decisions)

options.name: --since
options.description: a ref; decisions first cited after it are listed as newly cited

options.name: --out
options.description: where report.md and citations.nt are written (default: artifacts/report)
